question: Does a timeout before a late free throw make the shooter miss?
answer: Icing does not work: iced shooters +2.3 pp vs un-iced, relative to own FT% (CI +0.0 to +4.6).
findings: Not iced: 69.9% made (CI 69.5-70.2), shooters' usual 73.4%, n=59853.
Iced minus not iced, vs own FT%: +2.3 pp (95% CI +0.0 to +4.6).
method: First FT of a trip, last 2:00 of regulation or OT, margin within 3. Iced = defense timeout between foul and FT. Outcome = made minus shooter's leave-one-out FT% (min 20 other FTs); game-clustered bootstrap.
data: ESPN play-by-play via sportsdataverse, CBB, 2011-12 to 2025-26, 61,420 first free throws.
split_check: Iced minus not iced: +2.0 pp in 2012-19 (CI -1.0 to +4.8), +2.5 in 2020-26 (CI -0.8 to +6.1).
